name: pulse-skills
description: Find the right investors for your raise, draft the outreach one firm at a time, and share your deck with one link that shows you who read it.

interface.longDescription: Ask who you should pitch and get about 20 investors matched to your raise from a directory built from SEC filings and investors' own sites, each with a cited reason, the firms left out and why, and how each one takes pitches. Then draft the outreach one investor at a time: a cold email, the answers to a firm's application form, or a blurb to forward for an intro. When you are ready to send, share your deck through one Pulse link and see who opened it and what they read.
capabilities: Explain why each investor fits, with sources
defaultPrompt: Who should I pitch for our seed round?
Draft my outreach to the first four investors
